The secondary light gray (#F5F7FA) provides a clean, neutral background that reduces eye strain and ensures high readability for text and content. The accent amber (#FFAB00) is used sparingly for calls-to-action and highlights, drawing attention without the distraction of warm reds or the prohibited purple spectrum. The combination is professional, accessible, and entirely free of purple, violet, magenta, pink, or lavender hues.
